raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "6.2.1" %}

package:
  name: gspread
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/g/gspread/gspread-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2c7c99f7c32ebea6ec0d36f2d5cbe8a2be5e8f2a48bde87ad1ea203eff32bd03

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - flit >=3.2,<4
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - google-auth >=1.12.0
    - google-auth-oauthlib >=0.4.1

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - gspread

about:
  home: https://github.com/burnash/gspread
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Google Spreadsheets Python API
  license_family: MIT
  dev_url: https://github.com/burnash/gspread
  doc_url: http://gspread.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akashvyom
    - burnash
